source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In fixed accepted account removal, folder cache invalidation happens while folders can still resolve their server for on-disk cache keys. The account manager then clears its FindServer cache and removes the server from m_incomingServers before sending folder-deletion notifications. The actual moveCopy.folderDeleted listener uses findServer to ignore account-removal notifications, so moving both phases together changes that consumer’s result. The original1897303 landing interleaved notifications and cache removal; the later accepted redesign separates them. Fixed code skips legacy cache work under Panorama, tolerates synthetic folders with no disk path and reports cache/flush failures. Flush is an attempted persistence step, not a guarantee every entry disappears or a crash cannot lose state. No account/cache runtime test ran.
title: Remove folder-cache entries before server lookup and deletion notifications change
